tools.name: payments_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Creates a customer record. Use this when a new buyer checks out. A repeated call with the same idempotency_key returns the first customer instead of a duplicate.

tools.name: payments_create_refund
tools.title: Create refund
tools.description: Refunds all or part of a charge. Use this when the user asks to refund an order. Refunds cannot be reversed. Retrying without an idempotency key may refund twice.

amount.description: Amount in cents; omit for a full refund

tools.name: payments_transfer_funds
tools.title: Transfer funds
tools.description: Sends money from the platform balance to a connected account.

tools.name: payments_update_card
tools.title: Update card
tools.description: Replaces the card on file for a customer. Use this when the user wants to change their payment card.

tools.name: payments_list_charges
tools.title: List charges
tools.description: Lists charges, newest first. Use this when the user asks about recent payments.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the last charge id of the previous page
